purpose: Field-level enrichment evidence for Syncranicity national data center register; these are campus/transaction records, not extra facilities to inflate the census count.

methodology.missing: Null and empty lists mean not established in this research pass, not zero or no event.
methodology.matching: Attach only after address/parcel/campus identity verification. A broad company-city match is insufficient.
methodology.power: Capacity is not measured consumption. IT load, utility/substation capacity and unspecified power are distinct. Dated plans are not current operating load.
methodology.transactions: Preserve announcement vs closing date, aggregate deals, improved property vs vacant land and seller/developer chain. Reported company can be a parent, not the deed grantee.
methodology.approvals: Distinguish recommendation, scoping, land-sale authorization, adopted zoning, site plan and air permits. One approval does not establish full entitlement.
methodology.source_check: Primary company, SEC and government sources prioritized. One Goodyear price is explicitly secondary.
